set.cmd: if op item get --vault Private -- '{{key}}' >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null; then jq -Rs '{ fields: [ { id: "password", type: "CONCEALED", purpose: "PASSWORD", label: "password", value: . } ] }' | op item edit --vault Private -- '{{key}}' >/dev/null; else jq -Rs '{ title: "{{key}}", category: "LOGIN", fields: [ { id: "password", type: "CONCEALED", purpose: "PASSWORD", label: "password", value: . } ] }' | op item create --vault Private >/dev/null; fi
